import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        final int MAX_MASK = 1 << 20;
        double[] dp = new double[MAX_MASK];
        int[] cnt = new int[MAX_MASK];
        double[] res = new double[22];
        double[] p = new double[22];

        // Precompute cnt array
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX_MASK; i++) {
            cnt[i] = cnt[i / 2] + (i % 2);
        }

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = sc.nextDouble();
        }

        dp[0] = 1.0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0) {
                    sum += p[i];
                }
            }
            if (sum < 1e-6) continue;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0) {
                    if (cnt[mask] < k) {
                        res[i] += dp[mask] * p[i] / sum;
                    }
                    dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * p[i] / sum;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.out.printf("%.12f ", res[i]);
        }
        System.out.println();
        sc.close();
    }
}
